questions.prompt: What two kinds of help involving bikes does the Evesham group provide?
options: It repairs race tracks and teaches road safety.
It gives old bikes a new life and lends bikes to children.
It sells new bikes and runs football sessions.
It builds bike parks and holds gardening sessions.
questions.explanationZh: s5同时说明旧车再利用项目和儿童自行车借用服务；其他选项混入其他团体的活动或未提及服务。
